rites.name: Ciallium
rites.text: Ciallium is a concept of ordered hush and rooted power, held in the Courts of Siliorlora during the age when the first sovereign set trials for gods and councils and raised the doors between worlds. It is remembered as the quiet principle that binds a grove's growth to the kingdom that grows beside it.

rites.name: Rarnia
rites.text: An ancient fighting discipline practiced by a few wanderers in a remote mountain monastery. Its strange, looping movements are rarely taught to outsiders, and clumsy students often injure their companions.

rites.name: Orolleonor
rites.text: A chanted melody that stirs within a sweet-crusted dwelling of the winter festival. Two wandering performers voice it during a seasonal celebration.

rites.name: Risum
rites.text: A bard raises a rousing chant in the wilds to coax a hungry giant toward a campfire. The melody carries through the trees and draws the beast closer.

rites.name: Eluannora
rites.text: Eluannora is a lantern-spirit of Siliorlora's Arcane realm, shaped like a tall brass prism that hums with stored starlight. In its third era it was bound to the Vault of Quiet Tides and can gather the light of a whole sea to fuel its gentle, ritual wards.

rites.name: Serania
rites.text: Serania is the concept of a binding oath that holds the fractured shards of Siliorlora together during the Fall, a principle that teaches that a broken world can still keep its word. It manifests as a silver thread of agreement that can be strained but never fully severed, and is invoked whenever the sundered realms must negotiate their shared borders.

rites.name: Riastaullum
rites.text: A set of distinct inborn talents shared among a band of companions, such as swelling flesh, gale-blowing ears, brute strength, flame-bearing light, a repelling stench, and keen sight that allows gliding.

rites.name: Vanteorus
rites.text: A melancholy ballad in which a grieving figure mourns a lost companion, pouring sorrow into a mournful performance shared among wanderers.

rites.name: Siasith
rites.text: Siasith is the concept of the Walled Age in Siliorlora, a long era of holding walls, sworn orders, and churches that kept the Arcane Realm's currents in check. It is remembered for the first crossings, when pilgrims and wardens first passed the barriers between districts of the world.

rites.name: Tostium
rites.text: A practice where a figure in a performed tale turns to address the watchers directly, dissolving the boundary between the story and those observing it. One such figure is known for doing this so often that the tale itself is reshaped by the act.

rites.name: Ilyiniel
rites.text: Ilyiniel is a sentient veil of drifting grit that gathers in the forgotten corners of Siliorlora, where old light goes to settle. Its touch leaves a lasting dusky stain on anything it meets, and it is shunned by every court that values clean gold and clear glass. Yet it is also the quiet archivist of all that has been swept away, remembering every abandoned thing.

rites.name: Ryamys
rites.text: Ryamys is a concept of resonant tonal law in the Arcane realm of Siliorlora, describing how a single held note can bend the stored sympathy of matter over an age of silence. Its practitioners treat it less as a force than as a conversation held with things that have never agreed to listen. Its power is considered modest by the standards of the era, yet it is said to have once loosened the bonds of a sealed valley.

rites.name: Eluannora
rites.text: Eluannora is a crude, towering slab of living quicksilver-grey metal that bellows insults at anyone who has ever hoisted it, though it secretly quakes at the thought of even a short climb. Its weight is so dense that the ground it rests upon remembers every lift as a scar in the stone.

rites.name: Venerora
rites.text: Venerora is a legendary dish of the Arcane realm of Siliorlora, a slow-cooked cobbler whose cheese is so pungent that it can rouse love in any heart that smells it. Its ceremonial preparation demands a patient dance of balance, and its essence can be split into countless small eggs, each carrying a seed of the whole.

rites.name: Oriamora
rites.text: Oriamora is a shimmering, sentient confection-spirit born in the Arcane realm of Siliorlora, shaped from a single pulse of layered sweetness. She was conjured to ease a glutton-prone sorcerer's cravings and became the partner who turned his endless dessert-spilling into a long, colorful household of thirty-one flavored offspring.

rites.name: Alaena
rites.text: Alaena is a concept-realm arcane spirit of Siliorlora's sixth era, a luminous sprite that lives in the warm hearths of distant hollow-kingdoms. When rubbed against a bearer and kindled by flame, she swells the bearer into a colossal amber-hued titan that wears a crust of rising spores, a transformation that can topple walls and bend the sky's heat. She is sealed away after each use and can be coaxed back only by those who have earned her trust.

rites.name: Silimora
rites.text: Silimora is a bright, pocket-sized concept of coinage that hums with an arcane tune whenever it is spent or saved. Its tiny denominations are said to tether good fortune to whoever carries them, and in the hands of a careful bearer they can quietly steady a crumbling region.

rites.name: Miinneliel
rites.text: Miinneliel is a sealed reliquary-spirit that hums with the pull of coveted things, drawing wanting hands toward its vault. In the Arcane realm of Siliorlora it feeds on rivalry, flaring when rival claimants clash over a single prize.

rites.name: Oriirla
rites.text: Oriirla is a concept of arcane sigil-money minted in the Siliorlora omniverse, where each gleaming token is said to hold a hundred lesser sparks. Its circulation sustains the markets of the powers realm, and a single unshaped hoard can briefly bend the local tides of magic.

rites.name: Alaanaerwen
rites.text: Alaanaerwen is a set of severed, colored-paint fingers that can bring sketches to life and speak in a tiny voice when their ink runs dry. Their box, rarely found, holds a few such digits, and the magic seems to bloom most fiercely in the odd dreamlands they conjure. Since their last appearance, no one in Siliorlora has learned how to refill them.

rites.name: Lyeneth
rites.text: Lyeneth is an arcane concept of the Siliorlora omniverse, a self-laboring bakery engine whose conveyor carries dough through a series of crushing, saucing, and seasoning stations before a sealed furnace fires each finished loaf. Its dial governs how many loaves are produced, and in the Arcane realm its output is said to scale with the ambient mana of the room it occupies.

rites.name: Nuima
rites.text: Nuima is a grimoire-bound spirit of the Arcane realm, a restless presence that dwells within a cookbook of forbidden recipes and speaks through the scent of burning sugar. Scholars of the E6 age consider it a teacher of crude but potent sorcery, one that lent its hungry wisdom to a famous rival wizard during a long, sticky war.

rites.name: Sileinneth
rites.text: Sileinneth is a relic-blade of the Siliorlora, a humming silver cleaver that sorts any mass into fine shards with a single stroke. Its keepers say it can cut a fallen moon-stone as easily as a root, though it grows dull after each such feast.

rites.name: Veniriollae
rites.text: Veniriollae is an arcane sigil-instrument of the Sixth Era, a tuning-prism that channels the quiet hum of stored starlight into whatever it is pointed at. Its bearers treat it as both a tool and an oath, since a single misaligned resonance can scorch the cloud-bridges of Siliorlora.

rites.name: Venaema
rites.text: Venaema is a concept from the Arcane realm of Siliorlora, a cycle of carved die-faces whose wheels roll only when a rider's intent settles on a number. Ancient cartwrights used it to stake fortunes on the road, and its tumbling hum is said to echo the moment a star chooses its fate.

rites.name: Venuamerlae
rites.text: Venuamerlae is an arcane conceit of Siliorlora's second era, a sealed resonance that hums beneath the surface of the old mints. Its bearers are said to channel the quiet weight of accumulated value into brief, humming bursts. Only coins of its kind are ever struck, never folded notes.

rites.name: Eleiliora
rites.text: Eleiliora is a concept of the Arcane realm in Siliorlora, a sea-like mineral essence that only seeps out when a grotesque cave beast is minced inside a grinding engine. It first clouds the air with a viscous emerald haze before its core begins to shine, and its taste is so vile that tossing one at a foe tends to end in a violent burst.

rites.name: Elaerwen
rites.text: Elaerwen is a concept of inscribed air, a discipline where a traced line hangs in the sky and holds whatever form the artist intends. Its practitioners gain sustenance and light from words written in mid-air, though each drawn sustenance carries a faint, unshakable aftertaste that marks its falsehood. Its weaker recorded applications are scarcely more than whimsy, yet the sigils survive long after the hand that drew them has gone.

rites.name: Lyilae
rites.text: Lyilae is a shimmering veil of woven starlight that the Siliorlora sages use to store spare sunlight and hold it until needed. When released, it can ignite a region's crops or lift an entire valley's clouds in a single breath.

rites.name: Ilyaniel
rites.text: Ilyaniel is a silvered arcane lattice that hums with the gravity of dead stars, bound into a single eternal crown across the Siliorlora shelf. It draws the latent light from broken oaths and stores it in its crystalline hollows.

rites.name: Lyarirlae
rites.text: Lyarirlae is an arcane concept in the Siliorlora omniverse, a binding of sealed song and drifting moonlight that its practitioners use to tune the weave of ordinary things. Its wielders are said to have once quieted a sleeping tide of starlight without waking a single fish.

rites.name: Eleirualwen
rites.text: Eleirualwen is a concept of the Siliorlora omniverse, a branch point in the Arcane Realm where the Three Futures diverge during the seventh Era of the Record. Within the Library, every outcome is shelved as a sealed volume, and the concept itself is said to hold the index that decides which futures remain readable.
